title: A second byte order mark at the start of the stream is an error
notes: A document prefix holds at most one byte order mark (production 202: `c-byte-order-mark? l-comment*`), and section 5.2 allows it only at the start of a document. Content characters exclude it (production 27, `nb-char`), so a second mark can start neither a comment nor a scalar: it is an error. The first mark is not a character of the text and is not counted; the second is the first character that cannot belong, at 1:1 (as in `diagnostics/position-ignores-the-byte-order-mark`).

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the native backend read the stream and the second mark was dropped.
